SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.est_duration AS estDuration, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.budget AS budget, c.company_name AS companyName, u.name AS clientName, DATEDIFF(p.deadline_date, CURDATE()) AS dday, 1 AS bookmarked FROM project_bookmarks pb JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = pb.project_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = cp.company_id WHERE pb.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_public = TRUE
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY pb.created_at DESC, pb.bookmark_id DESC
